workflow.caption: Workflow
workflow.title: How it works in your practice
steps: Hold the consultation; document the information given and the consent obtained.
Sampling: prick the fingertip, apply blood to the card, let it dry.
Send the card to the partner laboratory in the prepared envelope.
Laboratory analysis of the genetic or epigenetic markers.
Digital report with traffic-light rating and specific recommendations.
Review and action plan; follow-up measurement after 4 to 6 months at the earliest.

evidence.eyebrow: Why we state the evidence openly
evidence.title: A consultation tool, not diagnostics
evidence.text: This field is heavily over-promised. Our documents therefore separate established from preliminary evidence and name the limits of every method — including where a single value cannot be interpreted individually. With professionals that is an advantage, not a risk.

contact.caption: Contact
contact.title: Request terms
contact.sub: The analyses are supplied to professional users only. B2B terms on request, tiered by volume.
contact.note: The analyses are laboratory services provided by our cooperation partner and are not CE-marked in vitro diagnostic devices. They serve consultation and monitoring and do not replace clinical diagnostics. Genetic analyses are subject to national genetic testing legislation.
